name: Unsubscribe helper
author: Mail Triage
description: Finds unsubscribe links across recent mail, groups them by sender, and returns one-click links so you can leave many lists at once.

since_days.description: How many days back to scan by default

max_scan.description: Maximum messages to inspect per run (10-200)

tools.name: find_unsubscribe
tools.description: Scan recent mail for unsubscribe links and opt-out addresses, group the results by sender, and return a list of one-click unsubscribe links. Use when the user wants to reduce newsletters/promos or asks how to unsubscribe from senders.

include_done.description: include senders already marked as unsubscribed

tools.name: mark_unsubscribed
tools.description: Record that the user has unsubscribed from a sender (or undo that) so the sender drops out of future find_unsubscribe results. This only updates the plugin's own list; it does not change mail.

url.description: the unsubscribe link that was used, when known

undo.description: remove the sender from the done list instead of adding it

assistant.when_to_use: cleaning up newsletters, promos or mailing lists; unsubscribing in bulk
